random.part: Do you know what you love to hear most of all? Two shining little words. "Good girl."
There is a reward your soul craves, sweet thing. And it sounds like this. "Good girl."
Some words simply feed you. Two of them feed you best. "Good girl."

You feel validated... appreciated... so proud... wrapped in soft, submissive euphoria.
